RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be responsibly quantified from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications are strong, but a leadership appointment may also weigh management, regulatory expertise, strategic judgment, and interview performance. The announcement cannot establish who best met the criteria.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on why you were unsuccessful—not an explanation centred on the panel’s sex.

If you uncover sex-related comments, inconsistent criteria, or evidence of unequal treatment, raise those specifics. If considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not extend them.
